title: Recursive Offline Distillation via Entropy Gain Sampling and Answer Mixing
abstract: arXiv:2610.20914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distillation of reasoning chains from Large Language Models (LLMs) into their smaller siblings is a standard training approach. Frequently, researchers do not have full access to a teacher model and its internal representations, which limits the resulting performance. We propose a recursive offline distillation method combining two components: entropy-based sampling for selective distillation and answer mixing. Specifically, for three open models (3-4B), at each epoch, we sample reasoning chains weighted by entropy difference with an auxiliary medium model (70-72B) and, next, supplement thinking traces with single-token ground truth answers. Our approach consistently outperforms naive distillation with comparable data budgets ($57.15 \pm 1.01$ vs 51.61 on average) and offers a much steeper learning curve. Additionally, we present a comparative analysis of methods to generate and normalize distillation traces.

translated_title: 基于熵增益采样与答案混合的递归离线蒸馏
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型（LLM）的推理链蒸馏到较小模型中是一种标准的训练方法。然而，研究人员通常无法完全访问教师模型及其内部表示，这限制了最终性能。我们提出了一种递归离线蒸馏方法，结合两个组件：用于选择性蒸馏的基于熵的采样和答案混合。具体而言，针对三个开源模型（3-4B），在每个训练周期，我们以与辅助中等模型（70-72B）之间的熵差异为权重采样推理链，然后用单token的真实答案补充思维轨迹。在相当的数据预算下，我们的方法始终优于朴素蒸馏（平均 57.15 ± 1.01 对 51.61），并且学习曲线明显更陡峭。此外，我们对生成和规范化蒸馏轨迹的各种方法进行了比较分析。
tldr: 该论文提出一种递归离线蒸馏方法，通过以与辅助中等模型的熵差异为权重采样推理链（熵增益采样），并用单token真实答案补充思维轨迹（答案混合），在相同数据预算下显著优于朴素蒸馏并呈现更陡峭的学习曲线。
